description:
Because:

* A resolution pinned class-validator to 0.14.1.
* From 0.14.2, validate() without options rejects undecorated classes.

This commit:

* Removes the resolution and moves root class-validator to ^0.15.1.
* Adds top-level decorators to two payments result classes.
* Skips the unknownValue check in ModelDataProvider.validate().

Closes FXA-11987
